notes: Inbound via Shopify app listing; signed up self-serve, then booked discovery call. Founder (Lina Morales) very hands-on: 'need product Q&A to match synonyms and brand voice.' Core asks: fast, cheap during spikes, easy integration. Primary workloads = product Q&A (customer-facing chat on product pages) + nightly catalog enrichment (attribute extraction, dedupe) + embeddings for search boost. Catalog size ~80k SKUs; bursts up to ~100 rps during promos; baseline 5-15 rps. Cost-sensitive — wants ballpark TCO before committing. Security: SOC2 preferred, SSO for admin UI, audit logs for API keys. Prefers hosted API for speed of integration; open to Dedicated only if committed spend required. POC plan agreed: 14-day self-serve POC using hosted API keys, two endpoints: answers (Q&A) + embeddings (search/enrichment). We recommended prefix caching + short TTL for product descriptions to cut token cost. Sent quickstart snippet and sample prompts (2026-03-08). Sent security FAQ and SOC2 pointer (2026-03-09). Lina requested token-cost examples for 3 common prompt templates. AE to provide cost calc + sample metric dashboard template.
